title: 2026 Holiday Shipping Deadlines for USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL
summary: EasyPost - 2026 Holiday Shipping Deadlines for USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL %
body_markdown:
Ship with confidence this holiday season by marking your calendars with crucial shipping deadlines. USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL and more have released their end-of-year schedules so you can make sure your customers’ packages arrive just in time.*


Each carrier has different ship-by dates and holiday hours, so please double-check your services below. The ship-by date is the day the package is handed off to the carrier.


Want to learn about peak season surcharges? See our 2026 peak surcharge blog


[here](https://www.easypost.com/blog/peak-season-surcharges-2026/) .


**Delivery dates may vary based on origin, destination, carrier acceptance time, and other conditions.*


##


Always arrive on time with Luma AI


Make your holiday shipping more reliable with Luma AI. As an EasyPost customer, you have access to


[Luma AI](https://www.easypost.com/products/luma/) , our shipping tool trained on billions of shipments. Its delivery date estimates are 39% more accurate than carrier SLAs by making custom calculations based on your exact service, origin, destination, and ship date.
